name: state-machine-invariants
description: Static analyser for state machines (XState v5 createMachine() in TS/JS, or a small flat YAML schema). Reports unreachable states, sink/deadlock states, dead transitions (literal-false guards), overlapping guards under XState's first-match rule, and unused events declared but never consumed. Use when asked to audit, verify, model-check, or find bugs in a state machine.
